$comment: RFC-0028. This wrapper is docs/knowledge-work-pipeline.mmd promoted from a hand-maintained diagram into the machine-readable source that diagram is now generated from. It is a wrapper, not a loop: the generator at its centre is chosen at run time from whichever artifact the user actually wants.
name: ship-a-draft
description: Take raw mess to a stakeholder-ready artifact by wrapping any skilldrop generator in the two passes either side of it — structured intake before, critique and machine-residue scrub after. Use when the user has notes, a transcript, or a ticket and wants a finished document rather than a first draft.

stages.intent: Collect the raw input once, into the shape the chosen generator expects, tagging every field explicit / implied / inferred / missing.
Run the generator the brief was shaped for. Any artifact skill is legal here — that choice is the wrapper's whole point.
Review the draft against the same rubric the generator was held to.
Strip what the machine left behind before the artifact leaves the building. Surface pass only — never a substitute for the critique above.
